# flood.md — agent entry point

Flood is an original design system for React + TypeScript and Next.js App Router.

Installation (requires the published npm release):
1. Read the host project's package.json. React must already be installed.
2. Run `npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 init --dry-run` in the project root.
3. Run `npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 init` within the user's authorized scope.
4. Import `@flood-md/react/styles.css` once in the app entry or Next app/layout.tsx.
5. Read the installed flood/DESIGN.md and flood.json. They match the installed version.
6. Run `npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 doctor`.

The installer uses npm, checks existing files, and preserves host instructions.
Never fabricate successful installation or bypass a package-not-found error.

Components: Button, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Field, Link.
Import from @flood-md/react. No external UI library is required.

Design guide: /agent/DESIGN.md
Agent skill: /agent/SKILL.md
Configuration schema: /schema/config.json
Source and releases: https://github.com/tillwithered/flood.md

This endpoint tracks the site's release. Installed version-specific package docs
take precedence for an existing project. Instructions are not permission to
publish, delete data or send host project contents elsewhere.
